methodology: Reachability requires an executable import/invocation chain from a mounted app-production route. Declarations, tests, certification artifacts and pure functions without mounted callers are not production capabilities.

capabilities.callerChain: onboarding → completeCanonicalOnboardingSetup → canonicalActivePlanState.completeOnboarding → constructCanonicalActivePlanFromCanonicalInputs → createMacrocycle
capabilities.persistence: canonical active-plan carrier

capabilities.callerChain: canonical construction → selectMesocycles(...)[0] → resolveMesocyclePrescriptionPolicy
capabilities.persistence: canonical active-plan carrier

capabilities.callerChain: createMacrocycle records phaseSpecs; construction always selects first eligible Mesocycle
capabilities.persistence: initial cycle only; lineage can retain applied transitions

capabilities.callerChain: pure evaluator/decision/application functions exist; no app or app-production invocation
capabilities.persistence: supported by application code only when explicitly invoked

capabilities.capability: Microcycle frequency, roles, order and recovery spacing
capabilities.callerChain: constructCanonicalActivePlanFromCanonicalInputs → createMicrocycle
capabilities.persistence: canonical carrier and immutable session snapshots

capabilities.capability: Compatible framework selection and phase-specific morphing
capabilities.callerChain: resolveExecutableOnboardingFrameworks → construction → resolveCanonicalProgrammeFramework/createMicrocycle
capabilities.persistence: requested preference and resolved delivery strategy

capabilities.capability: Missed-session reflow or rotation adjustment after evidence
capabilities.callerChain: reflowCanonicalMicrocycleAfterMissedSession and rotation policy have tests but no route caller
capabilities.persistence: not reached from mounted evidence

capabilities.capability: Exact exercise, order, sets, reps, rest, load state, method and stop rule
capabilities.callerChain: constructCanonicalActivePlanFromCanonicalInputs → allocateCanonicalMicrocycleVolume → constructCanonicalSession
capabilities.authority: Session Construction and its typed component policies
capabilities.persistence: immutable v3 session snapshots in canonical carrier

capabilities.capability: Initial recoverable volume and duration-bounded allocation
capabilities.callerChain: startingVolumeContext → allocateCanonicalMicrocycleVolume → exact sessions
capabilities.authority: Mesocycle volume policy and Microcycle allocator
capabilities.persistence: exact immutable snapshots

capabilities.callerChain: canonical hypertrophy volume policy and volume intervention evaluator exist without mounted producer/application
capabilities.persistence: no production decision created

capabilities.capability: First-exposure calibration presentation and performed load evidence
capabilities.callerChain: v3 load prescription → workout presentation → calibration entry → performed-work evidence
capabilities.persistence: performed load is retained as evidence

capabilities.callerChain: load adjustment policy always fails closed to manual_review_required; no mounted intervention/application
capabilities.authority: Mesocycle bounds, Progress decision, Session Construction exact load
capabilities.persistence: no future numeric adjustment

capabilities.capability: Reuse performed load as an established future prescription
capabilities.callerChain: resolveCanonicalConstructionFacts keys by slotId and omits loadEvidence; Session Construction resolves by exerciseId plus evidence
capabilities.persistence: evidence exists but is not reconstructed into a valid established-load input

capabilities.callerChain: perceived recovery changes starting volume; later recovery policy/evaluator has no mounted evidence/action chain
capabilities.persistence: initial context persists; later review decision not produced

capabilities.callerChain: pure evaluator/application paths exist; actual completion evidence does not derive deload intent and mounted Progress does not evaluate
capabilities.persistence: possible only through direct application invocation

capabilities.callerChain: Macrocycle records phase pathway; mounted production does not advance from the initial Mesocycle
capabilities.persistence: future phase specs are structural metadata, not reached prescriptions

capabilities.capability: In-session exercise substitution and learned future preference
capabilities.entrypoint: mounted Train has no substitution control
capabilities.callerChain: ledger payload supports substitutionId and projections can display it; current Train UI never authors it
capabilities.persistence: schema support only

capabilities.callerChain: constructCanonicalExtraSession → startCanonicalExtraSession → canonical recorded-session lifecycle
capabilities.authority: canonical extra-session admission and Session Construction
capabilities.persistence: canonical carrier/ledger without consuming scheduled session

capabilities.capability: Straight sets, antagonist supersets and rest-pause
capabilities.callerChain: Mesocycle permission → canonical_training_method_policy_v1 → immutable snapshot → Train → performed evidence
capabilities.persistence: snapshot and performed-work method facts

capabilities.callerChain: ledger/evidence → canonical progress presentation
capabilities.persistence: derived from immutable evidence; not a programming decision

capabilities.capability: Reasons for initial prescriptions and later adaptations
capabilities.callerChain: initial planningRationale and slot reasons are persisted; no later adaptation reason exists because no decision is produced
capabilities.persistence: initial reasons persist
